skills.description: AI memory accelerator / Token throttle valve: manage .workbuddy/memory/ smaller, sharper, cheaper. V3.9 core: real tiktoken token metering, task-relevance loading (--query/--tags: zero-dependency CJK char bigram + keyword/tag relevance, optional embedding backend), over-budget auto-compaction (hard budget gate), throttle one-click budget compression, tri-color budget alerts with 7-day average, --force for automation-friendly destructive commands, --json on every command for programmatic output, built-in self-test (prompt-injection / path-traversal protection checks). Perf: parallel summary generation (thread pool), ranked disk-signature cache, read short-circuit, fallback lru cache. UX: 24 short aliases, interactive progress, clean size labels, all token numbers marked "estimated". Defect fixes: prompt-get no longer crashes on missing template; backup accepts workspace arg. Use when the user says "memory manager", "token check", "throttle", "relevance load", "cache clean", "memory search", "memory analyze", "dedup", "backup memory", "prompt template", "token trend", "cache reminder", "memory report", "smart load", "diagnose", "memory rank", or asks about memory/token/cache/prompt management. NOT for: general file ops, code analysis, system cleanup, document editing.
skills.description_zh: Every session loads .workbuddy/memory/ into the context; the larger the files → the more tokens consumed → the costlier and slower it gets. Therefore, "saving tokens" means making the memories that enter the context smaller and more precise. This skill is designed entirely around that throttle-valve positioning.
skills.name: Memory Manager EN
